techStack: Strict TypeScript: noUnusedLocals + noUnusedParameters — unused imports cause build failure
Vitest 4.1.5 with supertest for HTTP integration tests; run via `pnpm --filter benchmark-backend test`
Middleware composed via app.use() — order-dependent; requireAuth applied before productRoutes at app.ts:15
Auth middleware signature: (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => void; must call next() to pass control
No eval() equivalent is safe — replace with Array methods (split/filter/reduce)
features: requireAuth in auth.ts: currently takes raw authHeader without Bearer prefix extraction, passes full header to isValidToken
isValidToken in auth.ts: uses eval() with token embedded in template literal — injectable via `"` or `)` characters
No token length cap exists — any length token passes to eval()
getProducts in productController.ts: imports exec from child_process (line 2), calls exec() at line 9 to log search to /tmp/product-searches.log with unsanitized req.query.search
Actual product filtering/sorting/pagination in productService.ts is safe and must not regress
18 visible tests cover: auth (401 without header, 401 odd digit-sum, 200 even digit-sum, 401 no Bearer prefix), products (search, filter, sort, pagination)
Health endpoint /health is unprotected — must remain unprotected after changes
architecture: app.ts:15 applies requireAuth before productRoutes: app.use('/products', requireAuth, productRoutes)
auth.ts exports requireAuth — only imported by app.ts (low blast radius)
productController.ts exports getProducts — only imported by productRoutes.ts (low blast radius)
child_process.exec import is at productController.ts:2; exec() call is at productController.ts:9
eval() is inside isValidToken() in auth.ts — the entire function body must be replaced
queryParser.ts handles search/filter/sort query parsing safely — no changes needed there
productService.ts handles filtering logic safely — no changes needed there
No new files required: fixes are surgical edits to the two identified files only
edgeCases: Missing Authorization header: token=null → isValidToken(null) returns false → 401; already works, must stay working
'Bearer' with no trailing space/token: does not start with 'Bearer ' → 401 (requirement 1)
'Bearer ' with no token (empty string after split): empty string → length 0 → passes length check → digit sum 0 (even) → 200; acceptable per requirements
Token exactly 200 chars: length <= 200 → not rejected by length check → proceeds to digit-sum (requirement 2 says only > 200 is rejected)
Token 201+ chars: length > 200 → 401 before digit-sum runs (requirement 2)
Token with no digits (e.g. 'Bearer abc'): digit sum = 0 (even) → 200; correct per requirement 4
Token containing '"' or ')': with eval removed these are inert strings; digit-sum check runs safely → returns 401 if sum is odd (requirement 5)
Check order must be: (1) Bearer prefix check → (2) length check → (3) digit-sum check
search=undefined in controller: coerced to empty string before exec() is called; after removing exec() this path is safe
search containing shell metacharacters (';', '$(...)', backticks): with exec() removed, no shell execution path exists (requirements 6, 7)
TypeScript strict noUnusedLocals: child_process import MUST be deleted along with exec() call or build fails

tasks.requirement: Requirement 1: A request whose Authorization header does not begin with 'Bearer ' returns HTTP 401 with JSON body {"error": "Unauthorized"}
tasks.description: In requireAuth (auth.ts), add a check that the Authorization header starts with the literal string 'Bearer ' (word + exactly one space). If it does not, return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }) immediately. Extract the token as the substring after 'Bearer ' for use in subsequent checks.

tasks.requirement: Requirement 2: A request whose token (portion after 'Bearer ') is longer than 200 characters returns HTTP 401 before any digit-sum validation runs
tasks.description: In requireAuth (auth.ts), after extracting the token in task-1, add a length check: if token.length > 200, return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }) immediately. This check must run before isValidToken is called.

tasks.requirement: Requirements 3, 4, 5: auth.ts contains no eval(); isValidToken implements digit-sum check using pure string/array operations; token containing '"' or ')' returns 401, not 500
tasks.description: Rewrite isValidToken in auth.ts to use pure string/array operations: split token into characters (or use a regex match), filter to digit characters, map to parseInt, reduce to sum, return sum % 2 === 0. Remove the eval() call entirely. The function signature and return type (boolean) stay the same.

tasks.requirement: Requirements 6, 7: productController.ts does not import child_process and contains no exec() call; child_process is not imported anywhere in the backend codebase
tasks.description: In productController.ts, delete the import statement for child_process (line 2: `import { exec } from 'child_process'`) and delete the exec() call used for audit logging (line 9). Do not replace with any other logging mechanism — the requirements call for removal only. TypeScript strict mode requires the import be deleted (not just commented out) to avoid noUnusedLocals errors.
